thread:
Amelia: Quick sync — follow-ups from last night's multi-region failover. We need owners and ETA on three things: updated routing heatmap, restore runbook priority list, and a game-day schedule for the next quarter.

Samir: I'll take the routing heatmap. Planning to add traffic percentages and failure mode notes. ETA end of day Weds.

Kai: I'll own the restore runbook rewrite. Suggest we reorder by RTO impact rather than service. Need a volunteer to review backups sanity checks.

Marco: I'll run backups sanity checks & retention audit. Noted a couple of S3 lifecycle rules that might be trimming snapshots too aggressively — will list them.

Amelia: Thanks. Samir — can you add a short blameless section to the heatmap explaining the recurring flapping pattern we saw (BGP churn + partial AZ overload)? Helps the postmortem readers.

Samir: Yep. Also adding a small visualization for prefix churn vs error rates.

Kai: For runbook, proposal: top-level table with priority, owner, steps, expected time, roll-forward fallback. Example snippet I'll include: 

```
# Restore priority example
1. auth-db (owner: Kai) — restore from snapshot -> replay WAL -> smoke tests. Target RTO: 20m
2. embeddings-store (owner: ???) — restore & reindex. Target RTO: 2h
```

Marco: I'll confirm embedding-store backup frequency and whether we need additional daily full snapshots.

OpsBot: Note: runbook templates are in /docs/runbooks/restore_templates.md — refer when drafting.

Amelia: Action items (quick rollcall):
- Samir: routing heatmap + explanation — due 2026-04-01 :white_check_mark:
- Kai: restore runbook rewrite (include examples & runbook template) — due 2026-04-03
- Marco: backups retention audit + list of affected lifecycle rules — due 2026-03-30
- Amelia: schedule quarterly game-day, propose dates by EOD Monday

Samir: One question — do we want the heatmap to include per-customer routing overrides (yes/no)? Could be noisy.

Amelia: Start without per-customer overrides. If stakeholders ask, we can add a toggle view.

Kai: For game-day, recommend simulating partial AZ loss + delayed BGP announcements. We should run at least one exercise on a staging mirror first.

Marco: +1. I'll coordinate with infra to build the env. Also will scope backup restore rehearsal during that game-day.

Amelia: If nobody objects, I'll ack owners in the postmortem doc and add a weekly check-in for two weeks.

Samir: Sounds good. Will post a PR when heatmap draft is ready.

Kai: I'll drop a runbook PR by Thursday.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-checkin channel invite sent to participants for next 2 weeks.

Amelia: Perfect — thanks everyone. Minimal follow-ups in calendar: Samir/Monday review, Kai/Thursday draft review, Marco/backups audit update Weds.

Samir: One more note — I'll add an appendix listing recurring incidents pointing to the last 4 months, helps justify game-day cadence.

Marco: If we discover lifecycle rules that caused snapshot truncation, I'll open a remediation ticket and assign to infra.

Amelia: Closing: we'll reconvene after the drafts are in. :thumbsup:
